thread:
Sam: Heads-up — CrimsonAI just asked for a Dedicated commit: 6xA100 reserved with a temporary 10% buffer for Q3. They claim seasonal promo spikes in Aug and expect sustained throughput increases. Can infra run numbers?

Maria: Do we have their recent peak traces? Need GPU-hours/week and p95 latency targets to size properly.

Josh: I skimmed their trial logs. They peaked at ~52 GPU-hours/day on a 2x setup during the demo week, p95 latency ~230ms for 2k token tails. They say traffic will multiply x3 when feature flag flips.

Lina: If x3 is accurate, 6xA100 seems like the lower bound. We should model both steady and burst demand. Also note: us-west region is near capacity in Aug (several reserved deals). Might need to place some capacity in us-central or add a cross-region fallback.

Ashish: Counterproposal note — our standard buffer policy is 20% for first-year commits to avoid noisy neighbor events. They asked for 10% for the onboarding quarter only. We can maybe agree to 12% with a staged ramp.

Sam: Can capacity-bot run a quick projection: monthly GPU hours, expected monthly tokens, and cost delta between 10% vs 20% buffer for 6xA100 commit. Also show provisioning lead time if we need to split region.

capacity-bot: Running estimate for CrimsonAI (input: 6 A100, x3 traffic, baseline peak 52 GPU-hours/day)

capacity-bot: Results:
- steady GPU-hours/month (no buffer): 52 * 3 * 30 = 4680 GPU-hours/month
- with 10% buffer -> 5148 GPU-hours/month (+468)
- with 20% buffer -> 5616 GPU-hours/month (+936)
- approximate monthly infra cost delta (rack pricing estimate): 10% buffer = +$28k, 20% buffer = +$57k (rough)
- provisioning notes: us-west immediate avail limited -> cross-region split may add ~24-48h lead time and ~5% networking egress cost for cross-region fallbacks

Maria: That cost delta is material for them. Do we have any short-term spare in our dedicated pool to offer a smaller initial commit + burst buffer? Could do reserved 4x + burst borrow to 6x for spikes.

Josh: We can support a commit of 4xA100 reserved with automatic burst to 6x using on-demand spare pool for up to 500 GPU-hours/month. That reduces their monthly commit cost but raises per-burst unit cost. Need to quantify billing language.

Lina: Two risk items: cross-region routing increases tail latency by ~40-60ms for some customers; and networking egress risk if customer routes model calls across regions frequently. Both should be in contract.

Ashish: Negotiation plan suggestion: offer 4x reserve + 1-month trial of 6x bursting (soft cap) + 3-month staged ramp to full 6x commit. Buffer policy: 12% first quarter, 16% next quarter, move to 20% standard after 6 months. Include automatic telemetry checks (latency, error-rate) to trigger rollback.

Sam: Sounds sensible. Also propose a discount carve for initial 3 months if they sign 12-month commit. That often closes deals.

Maria: I'll draft the commit math for sales. Josh/Lina can you add the latency/region notes and Ashish can add buffer language.

Josh: Putting region notes into a short doc. Quick snippet for sales to include in the term sheet:

```
Provisioning: Initial reserved capacity: 4xA100 (us-west), burst capability to 6xA100 (cross-region fallback to us-central) for up to 500 GPU-hours/month. Staged buffer: 12% -> 16% -> 20%. Network egress charges apply for cross-region routing.
```

Lina: Also add an operational SLA: automatic fallback to nearest healthy pool, and an A/B test window for the first 2 weeks of go-live. If tail latency increases >25% with cross-region fallback, auto-limit burst.

Ashish: I'll craft the buffer clause and the telemetry thresholds. Suggest we keep customer-facing numbers conservative: commit based on 10% scenario but contractually require 12% minimum for the first quarter.

Sam: Good. Maria, loop in sales and legal. I want a one-pager with the numbers and the negotiation levers by EOD tomorrow so PM can present on the call. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maria: On it. Adding action items: (1) finalize GPU-hour and cost calc, (2) draft term snippet, (3) prepare provisioning timeline.

capacity-bot: Action items logged: [calc_done, term_snippet_draft, prov_timeline_draft]. ETA: 18h. :robot_face:

Sam: Thanks team — if we can get the 1-pager and the softened buffer language ready we increase chance of getting a 12-month commit.

Maria: Will share the draft here when ready.
